## Overview

I summarized a full analytics workflow using BigQuery for data mining and Looker Studio for interactive dashboard communication.

The work helped me understand how cloud-based analytics tools can support larger and more flexible analysis than a standard interface can provide.

## Skills Demonstrated

- Querying large datasets with SQL concepts.
- Filtering, grouping, aggregating, and joining data.
- Connecting analysis outputs to dashboard visuals.
- Selecting charts that communicate trends clearly.

## Business Use

For a real estate customer engagement plan, BigQuery can support deeper analysis of housing demand, regional price movement, and long-term market trends that are difficult to explore in the GA4 interface alone.

Looker Studio provides a presentation layer where those findings can be organized into charts, filters, and dashboards for a nontechnical audience. That same workflow could also apply to sports marketing, where teams and agencies need to understand fan behavior, campaign performance, and audience engagement.
